name: gke-live deploy path + forge mode
description: The live GKE dogfood instance (app.warren.run, cluster warren-502318) deploys ONLY on releases (release.yml -> deploy-gke.yml workflow_call) or manual 'gh workflow run deploy-gke.yml -f deploy=true'. There is deliberately no push trigger (warren-8b5f). The gitignored deploy/k8s/overlays/gke-live/ comment claiming CI deploys every merge is stale. As of 2026-08-13 the instance runs WARREN_FORGE=app (GitHub App installation tokens, minted per operation); the static github-token secret key remains as the PAT-mode rollback: set warren-forge=github and rollout-restart.

README quickstart on a macOS Docker Desktop host boots clean (0.17.0: minted token, readyz all green, UI up) but is dispatch-broken: the documented -v "$(command -v docker)":/usr/bin/docker:ro mount points at /opt/homebrew/bin/docker, outside Desktop's default shared paths, so the container gets an empty directory at /usr/bin/docker and the image ships no docker CLI fallback — DockerProvider spawn ('docker' via WARREN_DOCKER_BIN) hits Permission denied. /srv/warren likewise materializes in the Desktop VM, not the host. Separate trap: docker run does not re-pull, so a cached pre-pl-3007 :latest (0.13.1) crash-loops demanding BURROW_API_TOKEN. Tracked as warren-5c42.
resolution: Boot path itself verified working end-to-end. Fix pending under warren-5c42: macOS docs note (static linux docker CLI + WARREN_DOCKER_BIN, or bake CLI into image), plus a boot-time exec check of the docker binary so the failure surfaces before first dispatch.

name: gke-live-campaign-controller-overlay-sync
description: Live campaign-controller config lives in the gitignored deploy/k8s/overlays/gke-live-campaign-controller: before any kubectl apply -k, sync newTag from the live Deployment image AND CAMPAIGN_ID from the live env (kubectl -n warren get deploy/campaign-controller -o json), or the apply rolls them back. Operator change summaries mount via configMapGenerator entry config/summaries.json + CAMPAIGN_SUMMARIES_PATH=/app/config/summaries.json env; the pr_intent stage skips with skipped_no_summary until that file carries the issue-keyed PrIntentSummaryFacts.

deploy-gke renders repo variables into strategic-merge Deployment env patches; an unquoted 'value: ${value}' turns numeric variables (4096, 1) into YAML integers and the apiserver rejects the patch ('The request is invalid'), failing the whole deploy job.
resolution: Quote the rendered value (PR #1200). Deploys are manual workflow_dispatch of main (deploy=true), not push-triggered.

title: Outgrow Supabase: in-cluster Postgres, Spot run pods, drop Filestore (pl-6076)
rationale: Postgres-to-Postgres keeps the drizzle journal and every migration untouched; SQLite has no export tooling and the events corpus is an RL asset; Cloud SQL needs VPC setup for similar cost. Only run pods are retry-safe, so Spot applies to them alone. Filestore has a 1TiB minimum with no smaller RWX tier.

title: Removed the Filestore repo cache; blobless partial clone is the default init path
rationale: Basic HDD has a 1 TiB minimum with no smaller RWX tier, so the cache cost ~$200/mo against a 2.9 GB repo. warren-3b44's partial clone needs no shared storage; the mirror cache stays opt-in for single-node RWO clusters (warren-554f). Do not re-provision Filestore for this.

title: Supabase decommissioned same day as the in-cluster Postgres cutover
rationale: Pro plan has no pause option, so the choice was keep-running or delete. Evidence for deleting: zero pooler client connections after the 15:37Z cutover dump, live warren serving 30+ post-cutover runs from postgres.warren.svc, Supabase held only public+drizzle (no storage objects, auth users, or edge functions), and the cutover dump md5 matched the bucket copy. The 7-day rollback window bought nothing a dump restore cannot.

description: K8s Spot preemption is classified as oom_killed/provider_error: when a Spot node goes NotReady and is deleted, every run pod on it exits 137, pod-watcher maps 137 to oom_killed, reap emits provider_error, and provider-retry skips (verdict unknown) — no infra-lost retry fires. Seen 2026-09-03 21:32Z killing warren-ea4e and warren-935a mid-run (~$0.25 lost, two hand re-dispatches).
resolution: Re-dispatch the seed from main; check kubectl get events -A for NodeNotReady/TaintManagerEviction/DeletingNode before blaming the model or the memory limit. Fix tracked in warren-a757 (read containerStatuses terminated.reason; classify node loss as sandbox_run_lost).

name: run-pod-memory-and-spot-capacity
description: Per-project run-pod memory lives in .warren/config.yaml resources.requests/limits.memoryMiB (resolveMemoryMiB in src/runtime/k8s/pod-resources.ts prefers it over WARREN_K8S_MEMORY_*_MIB). The warren project runs at 8192 MiB since 2026-09-03 because bun run check:all builds the Vite UI and runs the UI test suite and OOM-killed three of four UI runs at the 4 GiB cluster default. Autopilot NAP then picks e2-highmem-4 Spot nodes (2 pods each, 3920m CPU allocatable) and the us-west1 E2_CPUS quota (24) caps the fleet at two Spot nodes — effective concurrency 4 (warren-c55c).

Dockerfile ui-builder stage failed with TS2307 after warren-53a7 made the UI import src/client/ndjson.ts: the stage only copied src/core and src/ui, so bun run build:ui stayed green on full checkouts while the image build broke. Rule: every out-of-tree file listed in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include needs a matching COPY into the /build sibling tree (core/, client/).
resolution: Copy src/client/ndjson.ts + errors.ts into /build/client/ in the ui-builder stage; verify with docker build --target ui-builder .

description: [docker-quickstart-clone-root-outside-data-volume] The README docker-runtime quickstart mounts ONE volume and names it with WARREN_DATA_DIR (=/srv/warren), but src/projects/config.ts defaulted the clone root to a hardcoded /data/projects. Clones therefore landed outside the mounted volume, and every docker dispatch died binding the workspace into the agent container ('bind source path does not exist: .../<repo>/.git'). This broke the documented quickstart on every host OS, not just macOS. Fix (warren-5c42): derive the projects root from WARREN_DATA_DIR as <dataDir>/projects when WARREN_PROJECTS_DIR is unset, with /data as the dataDir fallback so the historical /data/projects default is byte-identical. Lesson: any warren-side path an agent runtime must also see has to derive from WARREN_DATA_DIR, the way src/runtime/local/paths.ts already did.
resolution: Fixed via warren-5c42 (PR #966): src/projects/config.ts derives the projects root from WARREN_DATA_DIR as <dataDir>/projects when WARREN_PROJECTS_DIR is unset, with /data as the dataDir fallback so the historical default still resolves.

name: gke CI deploy scope
description: deploy-gke.yml builds gke-live from ../gke only; opt-in Components such as postgres never deploy via CI, so cluster-bound changes belong in the gke overlay (warren-a5d2)
